Version 1.0.11 makes manual preview track ordering effectively instant, including on very large releases.

- Dragged rows are moved in place instead of rebuilding every cell in the track table.
- Existing checks, colors, tooltips, selections, and all non-dragged tracks remain intact.
- The order shown after the drop is passed directly to the final remux command.
- A local 500-track regression completes the reorder in single-digit milliseconds.
